Meet the Cat

Aleksei Vinogradsky

BA Hons in Architectural Studies · BA Arts in Music

A professional with more than ten years across architecture, visual art, drawing, music, and literature — a range that shapes an unusual, precise feel for decision-making, and a task-specific approach to every brief.

Collaborations include L'Oréal, Lancôme, Accor, Unilever, Carlsberg, Ahmad Tea, Swarovski, Armani, YSL, Prada, Valentino, Kérastase, Biologique Recherche, and Carita, among others.
